title: registration/v1
description: targets/<id>/registrations/<date>-<n>.yaml (F25-R5; D-3, D-10 v3.37): a submission to, or a registration in, a public registry of Lean-verified mathematics — Palomar — made by a curator or a listed steward of the target from a wrapper repository the pinned gate exported. Append-only: the latest record per registry id is the one read (a record with no id yet is keyed by its wrapper commit), and a later record with status `withdrawn` sets the registration aside. Nothing here is a verdict: the proof is what the attestation it names says, and the registry's review is the registry's. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

target.description: the target the record is filed under

registry_id.description: the registry's id once it has issued one (e.g. `PALOMAR-2026-10-09-000016`); null while a submission has none

version.description: the registry's version of the record (a correction or a dependency update is the next version of the same id); null before registration

wrapper.description: the wrapper repository the export wrote and the curator submitted

graph_commit.description: the graph commit the wrapper was exported from (`opn-export.json`)

attestation.description: the number of the attestation file for the registered proof's merge

proof.description: which proof: the node and the attestation its merge wrote

status.description: as the registry last answered: `submitted` (in verification or review), `registered`, `revision_required`, `rejected`, or `withdrawn` by the submitter

submitted_by.description: the curator's or steward's login (the pull request's author must be it)

url.description: the registry's page for the entry once registered; null before

challenge_sha256.description: the wrapper's Challenge.lean as the registry recorded it (its `verification.challenge_sha256`), null before registration

note.description: the curator's words, if any; escaped wherever shown
